bio.title: Bio
paragraphs: Since 2013, I've been part of the Wired team, stepping into the Lead IT Technician role in 2017. I specialize in network maintenance, cybersecurity, and developing tailored IT solutions to keep local businesses secure and efficient.

What I love most is the dynamic nature of the field. Every day brings new challenges that push me to think creatively and stay ahead of the curve. Knowing my efforts help businesses operate smoothly is incredibly rewarding.
